item.title: Sea Turtle Snorkelling Guide: Zamami & Okinawa Tours
item.description: Swimming alongside a wild green sea turtle in Okinawa’s crystal water is a bucket-list moment — and surprisingly attainable. The reefs around Zamami in the Kerama Islands are among the best places in Japan to snorkel with sea turtles, which graze on seagrass close to shore and surface for air right beside swimmers. With easy beach-entry spots and guided tours that know where the turtles feed, it’s an experience open to families and casual snorkellers, not just divers.

item.title: Kerama Islands & Okinawa Coral Reefs: The Complete Guide
item.description: The Kerama Islands — 30 km west of Naha — contain some of the most pristine coral reefs in East Asia. Marine biologists have recorded over 250 species of coral and 360 species of fish in the Kerama Shoto National Park. The water clarity here — what the Japanese call “Kerama Blue” (ケラマブルー) — is the result of both the Kuroshio Current and the absence of agricultural runoff on these small uninhabited or lightly populated islands.
